name: l2cap_unregister_psm

ownership.argument: Counterpart of l2cap_find_le_psm on the remove side. The registration/insert half was not identified on this build and is deliberately left open.

provenance.source: Matches a registry entry by the derived psm (request+38 plus the kind nibble of msg+1) and by entry+6, unlinks it from the *(owner)+16 list through 0xC7EAD28, then builds a 16-byte request node with 0xC840C54(16) and copies the entry payload from request+16/+20 before queueing it.

notes: Counterpart of l2cap_find_le_psm on the remove side. The registration/insert half was not identified on this build and is deliberately left open.
